original_run.failure_description: A synthetic one-scene contract test incorrectly required bitwise equality between the original NumPy scene-row reduction and the original Torch window-tensor reduction. Their scalar reductions differed at floating-point machine precision.

correction.reason: Allow the existing aggregation implementations' machine-precision reduction difference in this CPU-only synthetic test. Production K20 repeat/order checks still use torch.equal and exact proposal/goal/path SHA matching.

interpretation: This was a test expectation issue, not a predictor or sampler reproducibility failure. CPU mock contracts do not establish real newly trained NoSemantic validation performance. Formal training was not admitted because of the separately recorded GPU budget NO-GO.
